* 8. apply-create-core
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/apply-create-core
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/entities.clj
:LINE: 555
:MINS: 4.6
:END:

The atomic core for generic creates: create-or-humanise-error, a post-create whole-fn type-check, and the rename-slot side-effect. Since error-tolerance Phase 2 an ORDINARY type-check failure no longer rolls the row back — the write is kept and the diagnostics surface as ~:type-warnings~ on the success envelope. One class is carved out: a SECRET-flow diagnostic still deletes the row and returns the legacy ~{:error …}~ (the guarantee must not rest on the derived diagnostics store — docs/SECRETS.md).

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/entities.clj::(defn apply-create-core][src/graphden/crud/entities.clj:555]]

* 9. type-check-fn-after-mutation!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/type-check-fn-after-mutation!
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/type_check.clj
:LINE: 371
:MINS: 4.9
:END:

Reconstructs the touched fn-def and runs ~check-fn-def!~ after a mutation, recording failures in (and clearing fixes from) the per-branch diagnostics store. This is the type-check-on-write that ~apply-create-core~ relies on — an ill-typed fn persists, but never silently: every save re-derives its diagnostics. The ~:reject-secret?~ option is the security carve-out: a secret-involving failure is flagged ~:secret? true~ and NOT recorded — the caller rolls the write back and hard-rejects.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/type_check.clj::(defn type-check-fn-after-mutation!][src/graphden/crud/type_check.clj:371]]
- see also :: [[file:types.org::#types/check-fn-def!][check-fn-def!]]

:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/resolve-form
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/value_form.clj
:LINE: 399
:MINS: 3.3
:END:

The other direction of ~render-repr~: EDITING a value. A slot's effective type is classified into a form-descriptor tree — record, list, union, or leaf — purely, with aliases resolved and variants desugared, so the editor never has to know the type algebra. A depth guard keeps a recursive record type from unfolding forever.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/value_form.clj::(defn resolve-form][src/graphden/crud/value_form.clj:399]]

…and the descriptor becomes hiccup: a record is a labelled fieldset, a union a branch ~<select>~ plus one sub-form per branch (the backend pre-selects the branch the current value fits), a leaf goes through the form-fn registry the ~app/forms~ package populates. This is what ~GET /partials/value-form~ returns and what the Inspector swaps in — server-rendered, HTMX-wired (docs/PARTIALS.md).

* 20. create-secret
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/create-secret
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/secrets.clj
:LINE: 348
:MINS: 3.0
:END:

The write path that must not leak (docs/SECRETS.md): one ~POST /api/secrets~ atomically creates the OpenBao value, its custom-metadata, and the graphden fn-row + path-binding — with a vault-delete rollback if the graph half fails. The secret VALUE never enters the graph; only the path does, on a ~:secret-leaf~ child the executor auto-derefs through the ctx's vault handle. Note the shape: this public defn is thin orchestration over the same per-stage helpers the ~:cond~ in ~app/secrets/fns.edn~ consumes, so the Clojure and the graph path can never diverge.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/secrets.clj::(defn create-secret][src/graphden/crud/secrets.clj:348]]
- see also :: [[file:types.org::#types/taint-with-secret-if-tainted][taint-with-secret-if-tainted]]

* 21. run-tests!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/run-tests!
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/test_runs.clj
:LINE: 193
:MINS: 4.2
:END:

The tests subsystem (docs/TESTS.md) rides everything above: a test is a fn in a ~tests~-segment namespace, executed through ~apply-execute~ with ~{}~ args (pass = no throw), its status the newest execution of its CURRENT version — so an edited test reads ~stale~ by construction, no bookkeeping. After EACH test it nudges the ~test:updated~ NOTIFY, which is what moves the Explorer's dots one by one under the ✓ tests lens (its SSE ping stream). Note the ~platform?~ arm: the SHIPPED packages carry their own ~*.tests~ modules (~core.tests~, ~web.tests~, …), and a default all-tests run skips them — the rule is OWNERSHIP (~packages.owned/owned-fn-id?~, package-synced this boot), not intent, so a tenant's Run all spends its budget on its own tests. The platform set is gated by its own Clojure anchor instead.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/test_runs.clj::(defn run-tests!][src/graphden/crud/test_runs.clj:193]]

* 23. list-all-graph-entities
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: crud/list-all-graph-entities
:FILE: src/graphden/crud/entities/list.clj
:LINE: 624
:MINS: 3.6
:END:

The read side the editor lives on. One call, one shared lazy ~graph-list-env~ over the graph-cache, and a ~scope~ that picks a projection: the sidebar tree (namespaces + counts, O(namespaces)), one namespace's leaves, a search, a subtree, or the full dump. Every fn row is tagged with a ~:role~ so Types vs Functions is decided server-side. When the editor feels slow after a write, this is where to look — it is what every refresh re-reads.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/crud/entities/list.clj::(defn list-all-graph-entities][src/graphden/crud/entities/list.clj:624]]
